data.body:
[P1] Preserve recorded outcomes before stopping an unfinished batch's replay

With `minSuccessful: 1`, item 1 can fail before item 0 succeeds, then the invocation can end after both child checkpoints persist but before the batch checkpoint. On resume, item 0 now reports its cached success synchronously and sets `decided`; this guard prevents item 1 from being replayed. The resulting `BatchResult` reports zero failures and `throwIfError()` does not throw despite the checkpointed failure. Reconcile all previously recorded terminal child outcomes before applying the early-completion cutoff, retaining concurrency limits during reconstruction. Add a regression with a `STARTED` batch containing these two terminal child records.
